info.name: CineMatch - API as a Service (JWT Demo)
info.description:
Demo for the "API as a Service" requirement of the final project: an external call with a valid JWT (200 OK) and the same call without a JWT (401 Access Denied), on the dedicated route /api/external/reviews of service-reviews.

Before the demo:
1. Set the collection variable `jwt_token` with a valid JWT signed by backend-main.
2. Make sure `base_url` points to the correct URL for service-reviews (local: http://localhost:4001, or the Render URL in production).

query.description: Optional: filters reviews for a specific movie

request.description: Authenticated external call. Expected response: 200 OK with the list of reviews plus the requestedBy field proving the token was correctly decoded.
Same call, without the Authorization header. Expected response: 401 with a clear error message.
